what: Calcy IV scan-history CSV export: column list and how each field is written

source.file: A real Calcy IV history export, 135 rows, scanned 18 Sep 2026, published as a test fixture in the open-source pogo-grader project
source.note: Calcy IV publishes no column list. The meanings below come from the values in that file, the parser’s comments and Calcy IV’s release notes. 'observed' = seen in the file; 'inferred' = our reading of it, not confirmed by Calcy IV. Parse by header name, not position: the column set has changed between versions (PvP ranks added in 3.35a, Little League in iOS 1.0.7) and an older layout with different names exists (see olderLayout).

fileFormat.rowsPerScan: One row per scan. The same Pokémon scanned twice appears twice. Pokémon since transferred stay in the history until deleted there.
fileFormat.dateFormat: Scan date as M/D/YY HH:MM:SS (e.g. 9/18/26 22:27:37); probably follows the phone’s locale (inferred)
fileFormat.missingValues: '?' = not read, ' - ' or '-' = none / not applicable, '' = blank

columns.name: Ancestor?
columns.meaning: 1 = an extra row Calcy adds for a pre-evolution/ancestor calculation, not a real Pokémon; 0 = a real scan. Skip rows with 1.
columns.confidence: observed (the ancestor row has Gender '-', Nickname '-')

columns.name: Scan date
columns.meaning: When Calcy scanned it

columns.name: Nr
columns.meaning: National Pokédex number

columns.name: Name
columns.meaning: Species name in English, with form words after it: 'Sandshrew Alolan Shadow', 'Onix Shadow'
columns.confidence: observed; other regional words (Galarian, Hisuian, Paldean) assumed to follow the same pattern

columns.name: Temp Evo
columns.meaning: Temporary evolution shown at scan time (Mega/Primal), '-' when none

columns.name: Gender
columns.meaning: ♂ or ♀; blank for genderless; '-' on ancestor rows

columns.name: Nickname
columns.meaning: Nickname as read from the game (Calcy’s rename text if she pastes it); ☘ appears in Calcy rename text for lucky

columns.name: min IV%
columns.meaning: Lowest possible IV % (same as max when IVs are exact)

columns.name: ØIV%
columns.meaning: Average possible IV %

columns.name: ØATT IV
columns.meaning: Attack IV (average of possibilities, e.g. 15.0)

columns.name: Unique?
columns.meaning: 1 = only one IV combination fits (IVs exact)

columns.name: LL Rank (min)
columns.meaning: Little League PvP rank

columns.name: GL Evo
columns.meaning: Evolution the Great League rank refers to

columns.name: Box
columns.meaning: Calcy history box/folder (Default, Great League, Favorite…)

columns.name: Saved
columns.meaning: 1 = saved with the floppy-disc button; every scan is in the history either way

columns.name: Egg
columns.meaning: Unclear: 1 on all four lucky rows. Probably 'IV floor applies' (hatched/traded/raid), not 'hatched'.

columns.name: Lucky?
columns.meaning: 1 = lucky

columns.name: Favorite
columns.meaning: 1 = starred in GO

columns.name: Form
columns.meaning: Calcy’s own internal number for species + form + shadow variant. NOT the game’s form id (e.g. Froakie 2352 here vs FROAKIE_NORMAL = 3028 in the game files). Consecutive species step by 3 (Chespin 2346, Fennekin 2349, Froakie 2352), so it seems to count normal/shadow/purified per form. No published mapping.

columns.name: ShadowForm
columns.meaning: 2 = this Pokémon is Shadow. 3 = Purified (per the pogo-grader parser; no purified row in the sample). 1 and 7 = not Shadow (7 seems to go with older/partial scans; meaning undocumented).

columns.name: MultiForm?
columns.meaning: 1 = species has several forms Calcy could not tell apart from the scan (every Pikachu in the sample: 1, same Form number 1242)

columns.name: Dynamax
columns.meaning: 'D' = Dynamax; ' - ' = not; '?' = not checked (older scans). Gigantamax probably a different letter (e.g. 'G'), not seen in the sample.

columns.name: Height Tag
columns.meaning: Size class (probably XXS/XS/XL/XXL as a code; 0 = normal)

columns.name: Catch Date
columns.meaning: Date caught as read from the Pokémon’s page; '2026-?-?' when only the year is known

notInTheExport: Costume (no column; costumed Pokémon may share the plain form’s Form number, see MultiForm?)
Mega Evolution history / Mega level (only Temp Evo while mega-evolved, inferred)

olderLayout.note: A hand-made sample in the same project shows an older/simpler header. Its column names should also be accepted.

mappingToTracker.entry: Nr + form words in Name (Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian, Paldean). Ambiguous where MultiForm? = 1 (Pikachu, Unown, Vivillon, Spinda…): needs checking by hand.
mappingToTracker.h: ØATT IV = ØDEF IV = ØHP IV = 15 and Unique? = 1 (or min IV% = 100)
mappingToTracker.s: not available: scan a storage list filtered with 'shiny' and use the scan times
